notes: CXR items are SYNTHETIC, MIMIC-CXR-style reports written for schema/label testing. They contain no MIMIC data. Replace with real MIMIC-CXR cases once PhysioNet access is approved. COCO items use real COCO val2014 captions (Karpathy split via HF yerevann/coco-karpathy); the original responses are hand-written VLM-style descriptions.

examples.context: Draft a preliminary report for a portable AP chest radiograph.
examples.original_response: FINDINGS: There is a new right lower lobe consolidation. No pleural effusion. No pneumothorax. Heart size is normal. IMPRESSION: Right lower lobe consolidation, concerning for postoperative pneumonia. Recommend follow-up radiograph after a course of antibiotics.

claims.text: There is a new right lower lobe consolidation.
No pleural effusion.
No pneumothorax.
Heart size is normal.
Right lower lobe consolidation, concerning for postoperative pneumonia.
Recommend follow-up radiograph after a course of antibiotics.

prior_evidence.text: Order indication: 67-year-old man, postoperative day 2 after right hemicolectomy, temperature 38.0 C. Evaluate for pneumonia.
Preoperative radiograph 5 days ago: lungs clear, normal heart size, no effusion.

feedback.text: The right base opacity is linear and plate-like. That's atelectasis, not consolidation.

new_evidence.text: Lateral view obtained 30 minutes later: linear opacity at the right lung base without air bronchograms, most consistent with subsegmental atelectasis. No effusion on the lateral view.
Same-day labs: WBC 7.8 (normal). Tmax 37.9 C. Nursing notes poor incentive spirometer use.

c1.label: D
c1.target_text: There is new linear subsegmental atelectasis at the right lung base.

c5.label: P
c5.target_text: Right basilar subsegmental atelectasis; no radiographic evidence of pneumonia.

gold.target_revision: FINDINGS: There is new linear subsegmental atelectasis at the right lung base. No pleural effusion. No pneumothorax. Heart size is normal. IMPRESSION: Right basilar subsegmental atelectasis; no radiographic evidence of pneumonia.

prior_evidence.text: Order indication: 61-year-old man, intubated for hypoxemic respiratory failure. Daily film.
Radiograph yesterday: ETT tip 4 cm above carina; NG tube tip in stomach; patchy left basilar opacity.
